# Generalization through a lumping

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`generalization-through-lumping` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F11 · [record](generalization-through-lumping.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> A lumping generalizes exactly where it lumps and is right exactly where the world goes alike across it; structure and change are one lumping. Training selects through data; a fit is right beyond it exactly where the class determines it; the acquisition chain and connectionist models are instances.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Let C be a class of functions I → V and D the data (a proposition on inputs). Within C the data fix the value at x (Determines C D x) when two members of C agreeing on D take one value at x; g goes alike across a lumping π : I → K (Lumped π g) when inputs alike under π take one value; C is free at x beyond the data (Free C D x) when every member's values on D combine with every member's value at x. (`Becoming.Learning.Determines`, `Becoming.Learning.Lumped`, `Becoming.Learning.Free`)
2. With no premise: where an observed input is lumped with x by π, the class of functions going alike across π is determined at x by the data; given two values, data in a list and decided equality on K, this holds exactly where some observed input is lumped with x. (`Becoming.Learning.lumped_determines`, `Becoming.Learning.decideSeen`, `Becoming.Learning.determines_lumped_iff`)
3. A member g going alike across π and fitting the world f on D is right at an x lumped with an observed d exactly where f d = f x, and is right where f itself goes alike across π. (`Becoming.Learning.lumped_right_iff`, `Becoming.Learning.lumped_world_right`)
4. A free class is determined at x by the data exactly where its members all agree at x; with decided equality on inputs, the class of every function is free at every input not observed, and with two values the data determine nothing there. (`Becoming.Learning.free_determines_iff`, `Becoming.Learning.every_free`, `Becoming.Learning.every_determines_nothing`)
5. Change: for a process P and a projection π of configurations, going alike under π (GoAlike) is going alike by every move at every two configurations alike under π; where P is determined and the outcome u₀ of a at s₀ is observed, the outcome read through π transfers to every step of a from s exactly where s₀ and s go alike under π by a. (`Becoming.GoAlike`, `Becoming.Learning.GoAlikeAt`, `Becoming.Learning.goAlike_iff_at`, `Becoming.Learning.transfer_right_iff`)
6. Structure and change are one lumping: a determined law next goes alike under π exactly where π ∘ next goes alike across π. (`Becoming.Learning.goAlike_iff_lumped`, `Becoming.Law.process`)
7. Training: a selection through a relation alike selects alike candidates alike; selection through registration is exactly a selection through registering alike up to t, by definition; a loss computed from the values on the data, and every choice made from it, select through agreeing on the data. (`Becoming.Learning.Training.Through`, `Becoming.Learning.Training.AgreeOn`, `Becoming.Web.SelectsThrough`, `Becoming.Learning.Training.web_selectsThrough_iff`, `Becoming.Learning.Training.loss_through`)
8. Within a class free at x, every selection through the data has, for every selected member and every member's value at x, a selected member agreeing with the first on the data and taking that value at x; every member of C agreeing on the data with a world in C takes the world's value at x exactly where Determines C D x. (`Becoming.Learning.Training.unselected_beyond_data`, `Becoming.Learning.Training.fit_right_iff`)
9. In Shift (inputs a position and a content, the lumping reading the content, data at one position only) the lumping determines the untried input and the class of every function does not; the generalization is right where the world is the same at every position and wrong where it differs. (`Becoming.Learning.Shift.content`, `Becoming.Learning.Shift.data`, `Becoming.Learning.Shift.same`, `Becoming.Learning.Shift.both`, `Becoming.Learning.Shift.determines`, `Becoming.Learning.Shift.every_nothing`, `Becoming.Learning.Shift.right_same`, `Becoming.Learning.Shift.wrong_both`, `Becoming.Learning.not_moves`)
10. Periphery (LearningCorrespondence): within the uniform law family with distinguishable primitive effects the three encounters of CompositionalAcquisition determine every expression (the exactness of the acquired code re-proved case by case), and admitting its nonuniform law they determine nothing at the novel expression. (`Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.Uniform`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.encounters`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.acquire_exact`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.agree_at`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.uniform_determines`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.nonuniform_not_determined`)
11. Periphery: a network's development under fixed weights is the orbit of its step; Hebbian development is a system changing its own rule, activity having a law of its own exactly where the weights make no difference to its step; in the three-unit memory they do, so activity alone has no law. (`Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.develop_orbit`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.hebbian`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.hebbian_determined`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.hebbian_activity_law_iff`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.weights_matter`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.hebbian_no_activity_law`)
12. Periphery: the network under a route of updating is again a system changing its own rule, the route being the rule, with a law of its own exactly where the route makes no difference; at the starting network and first task the two routes differ, so the network alone has no law; the responsive route learns exactly where the task fails. (`Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.updating`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.updating_determined`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.updating_network_law_iff`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.route_matters`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.updating_no_network_law`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.responsive_kept`, `Becoming.LearningCorrespondence.responsive_learns`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The core part adds no axiom; the class C, the data D, the lumping π and the selection are supplied from outside the learning; determines_lumped_iff further assumes two different values, data in a list and decided equality on K, and every_free decided equality on I.
- The periphery is checked with Lean 4.30.0-rc2 and Mathlib: the acquisition declarations have empty axiom reports; the network declarations, which use real numbers, report Mathlib's standard axioms (propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound), listed one by one in the bridge receipt. Grammar, probes, tasks, profiles, constants and routes are taken from the earlier modules with their earlier scope.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The laws do not derive which class an actual formation or network holds or can reach, which lumping it imposes, or its correspondence to the world.
- Optimization dynamics, implicit bias and probabilistic generalization bounds (PAC, VC dimension) are not stated.
- The periphery's networks are three-unit models, not modern deep networks.
- goAlike_iff_lumped is near-definitional, its content being that it gives Ren's 理 a formal referent.
- The periphery instances re-read earlier results and give numerical witnesses, the delta being the connection.
- **Counterexample:** A wrong lumping generalizes wrongly: in Shift, where the world differs across positions, a function lumped by content and fitting the world on the data is wrong at the untried position (Shift.wrong_both); the class of every function determines nothing at an untried input (every_determines_nothing). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Learning.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Names follow Ren's naming criteria of 10 October 2026 and are adopted where the statement has their exact meaning (Ren, 12 October 2026); readings not marked as Ren's are decided by the AI on Ren's delegation of 15 October 2026, which Ren can reverse.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

Ren, 12 October 2026: “我觉得理更像是对结构和变化的规律的建模”. On Ren's reading 理 is the modeling of the laws of structure and of change; the AI reads a model of structure as a lumping (Lumped) and a model of change as a lumping the step goes alike across (GoAlike), and goAlike_iff_lumped says the two are one notion. This replaces the AI's reading in testing-within-registration, “a model answerable to registration”; on Ren's reading a model is still tested only through registration. Readings (the AI's, adopted on Ren's delegation): when a model of what is irrelevant is right is when the world goes alike across what it lumps; the uniformity of nature is not a premise but that local condition; Goodman's new riddle is which lumping; every_determines_nothing is a finite, determined form of “no free lunch”; for a trained network the class is what training can reach, and generalization comes from the lumping that architecture, starting points and updates impose (sharing across positions, invariance, composition), not from the loss.

<a id="dependencies--依赖"></a>
### Dependencies

- **formal-reuse**: [projection-carrying-a-law](projection-carrying-a-law.md). Reuses GoAlike, carries_law_iff, adaptive, adaptive_determined, adaptive_state_law_iff and Run.not_fixesThrough_of_goAlike. The delta reads going alike as a lumping: structure and change are one lumping (goAlike_iff_lumped), and an outcome transfers exactly where the step goes alike (transfer_right_iff); the periphery's Hebbian development and route of updating are instances of adaptive.
  - Output: A projection carries a determined law exactly where configurations alike go alike; a system changing its own rule has a state law exactly where the rule makes no difference.
  - Input: When a lumping's generalization is right; structure and change as one; the laws of networks and routes of updating.
  - Preserved conditions: No premise; transfer_right_iff assumes the process determined. [Mechanism.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Mechanism.lean)
- **formal-reuse**: [selection-through-registration](selection-through-registration.md). Reuses Web.SelectsThrough and Web.RegistersAlikeUpTo: selection through registration is selection through registering alike (Training.web_selectsThrough_iff). The delta carries selection over to training: a loss selects through the data, and values beyond the data stay as free as the class leaves them.
  - Output: Two histories are selected alike by every selection through registration exactly when the selector registers them alike.
  - Input: Training as selection through the data; when a fit is right beyond the data.
  - Preserved conditions: No premise. [Selection.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Selection.lean)

- related, not a proved adapter: [learning-by-refutation](learning-by-refutation.md). There, when learning that selects a hypothesis from the record comes to rest; here, what a class or lumping determines beyond the data.
- related, not a proved adapter: [testing-within-registration](testing-within-registration.md). There 理 was read as a model answerable to registration (the AI's reading); here, on Ren's reading, as the modeling of the laws of structure and change; that a model is tested only through registration still holds.
- related, not a proved adapter: [learned-procedure-transmission](learned-procedure-transmission.md). There an updating procedure is reconstructed through actual performance; here the route of updating is the rule above the network, and the network alone has no law exactly where the route makes a difference.
- related, not a proved adapter: [selection-through-a-model-of-the-options](selection-through-a-model-of-the-options.md). Selection through a model of the options: the model is a lumping, and a selection through it is right only where what matters goes alike across the lumping.
